name: University of Bath

baseline_requirement: IB offers for 2027 entry: 35 points overall with 6,6,5 or 6,5,5 at Higher Level for Pharmacy MPharm (B230), Sociology and Social Policy, Criminology and Modern Languages BA; 36 points overall for all other published undergraduate offers, with HL patterns from 6,6,5 (Chemistry, Biology, Management-family) through 7,6,6 to 7,7,6 in three Higher Level subjects including essential subjects (Computer Science 7,7,6 incl. 6 in either HL Mathematics; Mechanical/Aerospace/Integrated Design Engineering MEng 7,7,6 incl. 6 in Physics and 7 in either HL Mathematics). Contextual offers published per course (typically 6,6,6 or 7,6,5 HL).

Category A (Management, Management with Marketing, Business, Accounting and Finance, International Management and Modern Languages, Psychology, Architecture) and Category B (Economics, Pharmacy MPharm, Criminology, Sociology and Social Policy, International Development with Economics): IELTS 7.0 overall with no less than 6.5 in all components. baseline_requirement: Sheffield publishes an IB Diploma offer per course, stated as an overall Diploma points score plus a Higher Level slip (e.g. Computer Science BSc IB Diploma: '36, with 6 in HL Maths; 34, with 6 in HL Maths, and A in the Extended Essay; 34, with 6 in HL Maths and 5 in HL Computer Science'; A Level AAA including Maths / AAB including A in Maths and B in Computer Science). Examples (2027 entry): Computer Science / Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) BSc IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (or 34 with 6 in HL Maths + A in EE, or + 5 in HL CS); Mathematics BSc and Financial Mathematics BSc IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (Analysis and Approaches) (or 34 with 6 in HL Maths AA + A in EE); Physics BSc IB 34 with 6,5 (in any order) in HL Maths and Physics (or 33 with 5 in HL Maths and Physics + B in EE); Physics MPhys IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths and Physics (or 34 with 6,5 + A in EE); Chemistry BSc / Chemistry MChem IB 34 with 5 in HL Chemistry (or 33 + B in EE); Biological Sciences BSc IB 34 with 6,5 in HL Biology and a second science (or 33 + A in a science-based EE); Biomedical Science BSc IB 34 with 6,5 in two HL science subjects; Psychology BSc IB 34 with 5 in a HL science subject; Data Science BSc IB 34 (or 33 with A in a science-based EE); Economics BSc IB 34 with 5 in HL Maths (or 33 + B in EE); Business Management BA / Accounting and Financial Management BA IB 34 (or 33 with A in the EE); Law LLB IB 36 (or 34 with A in the EE); Medicine MBChB IB 36 with 6 in three HL subjects including Chemistry or Biology and a second science, and no less than 4 in all SL subjects; Dental Surgery BDS IB 36 with 6 in HL Chemistry and Biology; Nursing (Adult) BMedSci IB 32; Mechanical / Aerospace Engineering MEng IB 38 with 6 in HL Maths and at least one of Physics/Chemistry/Biology (or 36 with + A in a science-based EE for Mechanical); Civil and Structural / Electrical and Electronic / Chemical / Materials Science and Engineering / Mechatronic and Robotic Engineering MEng IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (or 34 with 6,5 in HL Maths and a science + A/B in the EE); Digital Media and Society / Sociology BA IB 33 (or 32 with B in the EE); Politics and International Relations / Criminology BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); Geography BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE);
